sql:
WITH target_activities AS (
  SELECT a.activity_id, a.molregno, a.pchembl_value, a.standard_type, a.assay_id, ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, ass.tid, td.target_type, td.tax_id 
  FROM activities a 
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id 
  JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid 
  WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293286' 
    AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' 
    AND td.tax_id = 9606 
    AND a.standard_relation = '=' 
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' 
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
),
canonical_smiles AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.molregno, c.canonical_smiles
  FROM activities a 
  JOIN canonical_smiles ON a.molregno = canonical_smiles.molregno
  JOIN compound_structures c ON a.molregno = c.molregno
  WHERE c.molregno IN (SELECT molregno FROM target_activities)
  LIMIT 1000
),
structure AS (
  SELECT a.molregno, c.canonical_smiles
  FROM activities a
  JOIN compound_structures c ON a.molregno = c.molregno
  WHERE c.molregno IN (SELECT molregno FROM target_activities)
  LIMIT 1000
)
SELECT ta.assay_chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
       ta.target_type AS target_type,
       ta.tax_id AS tax_id,
       ms.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles,
       dd.pref_name AS molecule_chembl_id,
       ta.standard_type AS standard_type,
       ta.pchembl_value AS pChEMBL_value
FROM target_activities ta
JOIN structure ms ON ta.molregno = ms.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary dd ON ta.molregno = dd.molregno
ORDER BY dd.pref_name ASC, ta.assay_chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000
